[{"insert":"Goblet Kickstand Squat + Goblet Cossack Squat
 
This is a super set for the legs and hips. The goblet kickstand squat keeps the back toe lightly down for balance so most of the work stays on the front leg without the demand of a full split squat. Move straight into the goblet cossack squat, shifting side to side to load one leg at a time through a deep lateral range. There is no rest between the two, so pick a bell you can hold in front for all twenty reps.
"}]
